title: Rforest Native
objective: Pin and port rforest 3103d396, implement the Harvey-Sutherland genus-2/3 Hasse-Witt batch adapter and packed N-API boundary, and validate exact modular streams on Linux x64/arm64, macOS arm64, and native Windows x64

handoff.summary: Pinned canonical rforest 3103d396c67cb1685131b1f11e84975cca335bdf (archive SHA-256 3e94db94c2cc518fa86633d136607ea2af1f4d327f0f5cbcc9920d474ce55754), verified and installed its MIT LICENSE and bundled zz BSD COPYING, and built the exact 20-C-source upstream closure on every supported host. Added the LLP64-safe clzll patch with a 64-bit GMP limb gate, reproducible Unix and clang-cl Windows builders, a host-neutral fixed-width C adapter, and packed Node-API genus-2/3 Hasse--Witt batches. The adapter accepts ascending completed-model coefficients as BigUint64Array two's-complement int64 words, returns stride-three det(I-T*W) residues, shares smalljac's process-global mutex, and gives explicit aligned direct/bad/characteristic-two/resource-limit rows. Dense Sage genus-3 oracles, genus-2 normalization fixtures, exceptional cases, truncation, ingress errors, and worker concurrency pass. Four-host fresh-build receipts: Linux x86_64 GCC 13.3.0, librforest.a 01559f66620e77df7aaa1dd4b97516c7d235ef8ec3d21fe675f0b71ea53113b2 and bridge eaa6387973a8146d735b620949cb427cecd4b1014fb982a0cfb13b41f9d8c2f9; Linux aarch64 GCC 13.3.0, library 6dec38f957a3d2b65da5f697dafbbdddaa4330c1f5f059222bc90e8f61d2b4af and bridge 5eb715629dd9d7985d702f05f82357f26ca9ea0f3c94854f99b1b95d1aee494c; macOS arm64 Apple clang 17.0.0, library e44b721fdcafceab65c0cd2d431425c1c3cc79a7b1498886e7ab707d92a6fafe and bridge cb220d838ca0860b48d41e86bc9d1ea18b7ed30a59e181e9aca88a280b665252; native Windows x64 clang-cl 19.1.5, rforest.lib 5b0dc82e15969972479a92614a5181b09a2ef8d65516935657f5a916d463d433 and bridge.exe 4d89c0000b44139fc8007e87c3537d5cea51f22d98c83dedcd5498d66b61c9d3. Every bridge printed 'rforest bridge genus-2/3 residue streams passed'.
risks: The native result is only det(I-T*W) modulo p; the ordinary Python layer must perform exact Weil-bound lifting and must not expose these rows as local L-polynomials.
The forest is capped at p <= 2^31-1 for an identical fixed-width contract across LP64 and LLP64. Exceptional rows above the direct fallback cap p=100000 deliberately report RESOURCE_LIMIT.

The native Windows standalone link emits existing vcpkg FLINT/GMP inconsistent-dllimport LNK42xx warnings; the adapter itself compiles with clang-cl /W4 /WX after suppressing that third-party header diagnostic, and the executable passes.

Broad repository-native and SEA suites were intentionally not rerun in this lane at integration's request; focused addon, dense Node oracle, standalone bridge, dependency rebuild, and four-host receipts are current.
next_steps: Integration has cherry-picked 221e0917, f6a05969, and c2212c95; include this receipt commit and classify the new adapter/header/standalone test in the integration branch native-code inventory.
Keep rforestCapabilities and rforestHasseWittBatch private to the mathematical lifting layer until the exact coefficient-completion contract is tested end to end.
